title: 1.2 Two mornings
unit_outcome: Explain a working day, compare two people’s commitments, check assumptions and account for a change of routine.
goal: Say what Ana and Luis do in the morning and when, with he/she and the -s ending.
grammar_function: Third-person -s/-es on A1's routine verbs: I wake up becomes Luis wakes up, I brush my teeth becomes Ana brushes her teeth, I get dressed becomes he gets dressed, I eat breakfast becomes she eats breakfast. Leaves home (A1 leaves, 1.1 leave home) closes each morning and links it to 1.1's workday.
prerequisite: A1 4.5 routine chunks in the I-form (wake up, brush my teeth, get dressed, eat breakfast), A1 3.7 his/her, he/she, whole hours with at; 1.1 leave home and the times Ana (seven) and Luis (eight) leave.
speaking_outcome: A clear final /s/ in wakes, gets and eats, and the extra syllable in brushes, inside the complete sentence. Do not require native-like speed.
